PAKISTAN BAR COUNCIL LEGAL EDUCATION RULES, 1978
PAKISTAN BAR COUNCIL LEGAL EDUCATION RULES, 1978
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 20th August 1979]
S. R. O. 737(1)/79: ‑In
exercise of the powers conferred by rule 16 of the Pakistan Bar Council Legal
Education Rules, 1978, and all other enabling provisions in this behalf, the
Pakistan Bar Council makes and notifies the following amendments to the
Pakistan Bar Council Legal Education Rules, 1978.
1. In rule 1 (ii) the words
"at once" be substituted by the words, "with effect from 21st
October 1979" and the following proviso be added to rule 1 (ii):
"Provided that those
Universities or Law Colleges/Law Faculties who held admissions to F. E. L.
Class on 2 years course basis after 16th November 1978, the date of
Notification of these rules shall not be entitled to admissions to F. E. L.
Classes on 2 years course basis, if such admissions are due before 21st October
1977, the date of enforcement of these Rules. Such admissions, if any, shall be
on the 3 years course basis."
2. In rule 3 (a) the words
"only will be eligible" shall be substituted by the words "will
be preferred" and the second proviso to the sub‑rule shall be
deleted.
3. In rule 3 (b) the words
"those holding Masters degree and/or" shall be deleted and the
following proviso shall be added to the sub‑rule:
"Provided that this sub‑rule
shall be relaxed for a period of 3 years from the date of commencement of 3
years course in Baluchistan University and/or University or Law College that
may be established in Azad Jummu and Kashmir and Tribal Areas."
4. Rule 4 shall be substituted by
the following:
"A section of a Class in a
Law College and/or a Faculty of Law shall comprise of 60 students or about, and
in no case exceed 80 students."
5. In rule 5(b) the following proviso
shall be added
"Provided that a degree of
LL.B., shall be conferred on a candidate only on his surrendering earlier
degree of B.L."
6. Rule 7 shall be substituted by
the following
"Part‑time teachers
should possess the" following qualification :‑‑
LL.B. or Barrister‑at‑Law
with five years standing at the Bar?
Or
LL.M., Ph. D. or such other
higher qualification, as may be prescribed by the Pakistan Bar Council from,
time to time‑
Provided that the honorarium of
the part‑time teachers shall be com mensurate with comparable pay scales
in other professional colleges:
Provided further that whole time
teachers, in matters other than academia qualifications and standing at the Bar
shall be governed by the terms and conditions of service prescribed in this
behalf by the respective Universities."
7. In proviso to rule 9 the words
"promulgation of these rules" shall be substituted by the words
"commencement of 3 years course in a University".
8. In rule 10 first part of rule
shall be numbered as "sub-rule (a)" and a new "sub‑rule
(6)" shall be inserted to read as under :
"(b) No new Evening Law
College or new Evening Class organised' by a Law College or Faculty of Law
shall be started."
The existing proviso to rule (10)
shall be read as proviso to sub rule (b) of rule (10).
9. In rule 14 (a) the following
proviso shall be added:
"Provided that there shall
be no exemption and no provisional admission shall be granted to failed or
compartmental students to the next higher class."
10. Rule 14 (b) shall be
substituted by the following:
"(b) One fails thrice in an
examination shall be debarred from appearing in further examination:
Provided that if a student fails
to appear at an examination within 3 years after completing his terms, lie
shall not be allowed to appear in the examination."
11. The existing rule 15 (c) be
substituted by the following :‑
"(c) The Inspection Teams so
appointed by the Pakistan Bar Council shall comprise of Members of Pakistan Bar
Council, Provincial Bar Council con cerned and two
Principals/Professors/Associate Professors of Law from the University."
